jobs.prompt:
Train 5, items 2 and 3. Tests first for each behavior.

2a) LEDGER LOCK RACE (tools/tickets.mjs:363, applySupersedeStale). The bulk supersede does a read-modify-write that shares no lock with other ledger writers, so a concurrent transition can be overwritten. Fix: make the write happen under the same scope/wave lock every other ledger writer uses, with no nested lock and no stale read: the CLI already wraps the call in withLock; inside that lock, use the fresh ledger (do not re-read a potentially older copy) and write once. Audit the other ledger writers that can run concurrently (transition/lockedTransition, applyDelivered, sync, phone paths) and route any that bypass the lock through it (or document why they cannot interleave). Add a two-process test: one process supersedes stale tickets while another transitions a different ticket; both effects survive in the final ledger (no lost update).

2b) SUPERSEDED DEPS (tools/tickets.mjs:615). A superseded ticket stays in dependents' dependsOn, so those dependents can never become ready. Extend the existing cancelled-dependency pruning (`pruneCancelledDeps`, used by transition) to also prune `superseded` dependencies, and call it from applySupersedeStale for the bulk case so dependents unlock and the prune is logged (same logPrune convention). Tests: a dependent waiting only on now-superseded tickets becomes ready/unblocked, the dependsOn entries are removed, and the prune is logged; done/cancelled behavior is unchanged.

3) OWNER CHECK (tools/scope-commands.mjs). The current supersede owner check only detects Claude Code; a Codex or Cursor agent session with a shell can run it, and `swarm tickets <id> --set superseded` has no owner check at all. Make one shared owner-only gate and use it for both the bulk command and the single `--set superseded` transition. Refuse when the caller is an agent/worker session: any of CLAUDECODE, CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT, SWARM_WORKER, SWARM_JOB_ID, SWARM_RUN_ID set, or stdout is not a TTY, unless SWARM_OWNER=1 is set (explicit owner override). Message: clear, e.g. 'tickets supersede is owner-only; run from the owner terminal (not inside an agent or worker session)'. Make the gate testable with an injected env/isTTY object. Tests: bulk and --set superseded both refuse with an agent env marker or no TTY and no SWARM_OWNER; both allow SWARM_OWNER=1 or a TTY. Keep existing behavior otherwise.

Verify: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/tickets-supersede.test.mjs tests/scope-commands.test.mjs tests/tickets.test.mjs -> all pass. Report exact commands and counts.
